'''Docking bay 10''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located in [[Eponte Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabaira]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tere Metallo]] berthed her ship, the ''[[Star Quest]]'', in docking bay 10.<ref name="Passages">{{JournalCite|7|Passages}}</ref>
